summary: The implementation of issue #14 (Geração de resposta LLM em Stream) meets all three acceptance criteria: AC-001 (async non-blocking TTS requests via IPC), AC-002 (incremental token emission with sequence numbers), and AC-003 (reconstructable complete response from segments). Electron-builder output paths in dist/ follow AppImage/deb conventions. Shader materials compile without warnings. IPC handlers follow preload context isolation patterns. However, there is one type safety blocker: the getTTSAudioStream method in src/preload/index.ts uses 'as any' bypassing type safety instead of returning a properly typed ReadableStream<AudioStreamChunk>
reviewedAreas: IPC Handler get-tts-audio-stream implemented with AsyncGenerator pattern
Sequence numbers for chunk reordering at renderer
Electron-builder.jsonc output paths: dist/ for AppImage and deb targets
GLSL shaders in src/renderer/App.tsx compile successfully
Type definitions: AudioStreamChunk and AudioStreamComplete interfaces defined
Test coverage: 10 tests in ipc-main-streaming.test.ts all passing (165/165 total)
blockers: Blocker B-001 [medium] Location: src/preload/index.ts line 28 - Type safety bypass using 'as any' for getTTSAudioStream method. The method should return a properly typed ReadableStream<AudioStreamChunk> or ReadableStream<{ seq: number; data: ArrayBuffer }> instead of 'as any'. Impact: Reduces type safety in renderer and IDE autocomplete for streaming API.

Blocker B-002 [low] Location: src/main/stream-tts.ts line 43 - Edge case EC-002 (fallback detection) is not yet implemented. The comment indicates this could be added for non-streaming responses, but it's marked as a known limitation in the PR rather than a blocker.

Blocker B-003 [low] Location: src/main/stream-tts.ts line 25 - Accept header set to 'text/event-stream' but LM Studio TTS endpoint returns raw audio chunks (MP3), not SSE stream. This is semantically incorrect but functionally works due to how fetch handles binary streams.

Blocker B-004 [low] Location: src/main/stream-tts.ts lines 57,61 - Sequence number starts at 0 and increments after yield, causing first chunk to have sequence 1 while complete signal has sequence 0. Should start at 1 and increment before yield for consistent ordering.
Blocker B-005 [low] Location: src/main/stream-tts.ts line 44 - Checking !reader is redundant since fetch() body always returns readable stream on ok response, could simplify error handling
fixes: Fix F-001: Update src/preload/index.ts line 28 to remove 'as any' and add proper return type annotation: getTTSAudioStream: (text: string) => ipcRenderer.invoke('get-tts-audio-stream', text)
Fix F-002: Remove or clarify the EC-002 fallback detection comment if it's intentionally deferred
Fix F-003: Update Accept header from 'text/event-stream' to application/json or remove since LM Studio TTS returns raw binary audio not SSE
Fix F-004: Change sequence numbering to start at 1 and increment before yield: let sequence = 1; then yield { seq: sequence++ }
Fix F-005: Remove the redundant !reader check since response.ok ensures body is readable stream
validation: npm run test - Result: All 165 tests pass (10 new streaming tests included). npm run type-check - Result: No errors in source files. Git diff review confirms implementation matches PR description.
residualRisks: R-001: If LM Studio API changes streaming format, error handling may need updates
R-002: Large text inputs may cause memory pressure before streaming starts (documented limitation)
R-003: No exponential backoff for retries on network failures (documented limitation)
R-004: Sequence number inconsistency on generator cancellation mid-stream (handled by cleanup via stream.return()
